title: Plan a launch promotion
summary: Plan a four-week launch promotion for a new shampoo that stays within the margin floor.
deliverable: A promotion plan ready for trade approval
brief: Plan a 4-week launch promotion for new shampoo SKU-5502 in modern trade. Target: 12,000 units sold. Keep within the company's 35% gross-margin floor.
sources:
SKU-5502: list price 6.00, unit cost 3.30.
Pricing policy PP-3: no promotion may take gross margin below 35%.
Claims policy CL-1: no 'clinically proven' or medical claims without a filed study.
Last launch (SKU-4410): 2-for-1 bundles beat straight discounts on trial by 18%.
draftA:
Mechanic: 30% off for 4 weeks, promo price 4.20.
In-store: end-cap displays in the top 40 stores.
Message: 'Clinically proven to reduce hair fall.'
Forecast: 12,000 units at 4.20.
draftB:
Mechanic: 15% off, promo price 5.10 (gross margin 35.3%), plus a free 50 ml travel size with every purchase in week 1.
In-store: shelf talkers in all stores, end-caps in the top 40.
Message: 'Gentle daily care, new formula.'
Forecast: 12,000 units at 5.10, gross profit 21,600.
reviewOfA:
D-A1 · P0 · Breaks the margin floor
  At 4.20 the gross margin is (4.20 - 3.30) ÷ 4.20 = 21.4%, below the 35% floor in PP-3. The deepest allowed discount is about 15.4% (price 5.08).
D-A2 · P0 · Unsupported claim
  'Clinically proven' needs a filed study under CL-1; none exists.
reviewOfB:
D-B1 · P1 · Gift cost not counted
  The free travel size has a cost that should be included in the margin check for week 1.
Strengths: stays above the floor, and the message makes no medical claim.
synthesis:
Kept from B: 15% off at 5.10 and the 'gentle daily care' message.
Kept from A: end-cap displays in the top 40 stores.
Fixed D-A1 and D-A2: no 30% discount and no clinical claim.
Fixed D-B1: the travel size moves to a 2-for-1 bundle in weeks 3-4 (the mechanic that drove trial last launch), and its cost is in the margin check.
Defects resolved: 3 of 3.

checks.name: Margin floor holds
checks.detail: Every mechanic keeps gross margin at or above 35%, gifts included.

checks.name: Forecast adds up
checks.detail: 12,000 units × 1.80 margin per unit = 21,600 gross profit.

approval: Approved by the brand manager and the trade finance controller.
deliver: Plan sent to the key account team with store lists, the price file and the approved artwork brief.
